# Helm

> CEO Operating System. Run the business. Don't chase it.

Built for CEOs running companies of up to 50 people.

Helm is a CEO operating system: one cockpit for money, pipeline, people,
department work, and decisions — Briefing, Decision Center, Financials,
Ask Helm, and department lanes (Production, Procurement, Legal, HR,
Maintenance, Sales).

## Current pricing

Source of truth in the product repo: frontend/src/lib/marketingCopy.js (PLANS).
Do not use older docs (e.g. memory/PRD.md) or guessed figures.

- Free: $0 (3 seats) — Small teams trying Helm
- Starter: $15/mo (10 seats) — Small businesses
- Growth: $39/mo (25 seats) — Growing businesses
- Business: $99/mo (50 seats) — Larger companies

Paid plans (Starter, Growth, Business) include a 7-day free trial.
Billing is via Paddle. Cancel anytime from Billing.
